summary.plain: The U.S. national laboratory for nuclear physics in Newport News, Virginia. Its CEBAF accelerator fires a continuous beam of electrons at atomic nuclei to study the quarks and gluons that make up protons and neutrons.
summary.technical: DOE Office of Science national laboratory (Newport News, Virginia) operating CEBAF, a superconducting recirculating electron linac originally at 6 GeV and upgraded to 12 GeV (dedicated 2018); managed by SURATech, LLC.
